item.title: Oitsume ~Ryoujoku no Utage~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ponytail Soft
  • 発売日: 2003-10-03
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 鬼爪 ～陵辱の宴～
  • 英語名: Oitsume Ryoujoku no Utage

别名

  • 鬼爪(ヲイツメ)～陵辱の宴～

あらすじ

Main character as well as a number of other participants are thrown into an old abandoned school building. With traps set everywhere, nine people have to compete for food, shelter and trust on their escape survival path. What’s the purpose of this madness? Who’s the mastermind? What’s the fate of the winner and losers?

item.title: Ponkan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ponytail Soft
  • 発売日: 1994-02-11
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ポンカン
  • 英語名: Ponkan

あらすじ

Ponkan consists of three unrelated scenarios. In the first one a young private investigator attempts to unravel a sex-related conspiracy. The second scenario is set in medieval fantasy environment and focuses on two warrior sisters who got captured and thrown into a dungeon by monsters. Finally, the third scenario is dedicated to “sex fighting” between young women of various cultural backgrounds.

item.title: Tensen Nyan Nyan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ponytail Soft
  • 発売日: 1992-10-14
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 天仙娘々
  • 英語名: Tensen Nyan Nyan

あらすじ

Once upon a time, way back in ancient China, the youkai “Mahjong King” roamed the land. The Mahjong King had a terrifying (and honestly, kinda enviable) magic: he could strip young maidens naked so they’d never wear clothes again! To seal away this wild sorcery, three pink-haired girls—adeptuses like the fairy Suzuka—go all out with magic, violence, trickery, and their own desires in a wild, jaw-dropping adventure!

  • 英語名: Pocky 2 Kaijin Aka Mantle no Chousen

别名

  • Pokki 2

あらすじ

Pocky Private High School is in trouble. A mysterious person plays all sorts of malicious pranks, steals valuable objects, and harasses female students. The fear of the horrible ghost, the Aka Manto (Red Cap), is surfacing. It’s up to a team of female students, led by Miki, to investigate the strange occurrences and find the true culprit.

item.title: Pocky
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ponytail Soft
  • 発売日: 1989-01
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ポッキー
  • 英語名: Pocky

别名

  • Pokky

あらすじ

The principal of the Pocky Private High School is a lecherous man who thinks only about having sex with female students. One day he announces a competition for the male students, promising a reward for the one who brings him most girls’ underwear. The protagonist is one of these students who must succeed in this dubious enterprise.
